title: Binning files is boring so I made an incremental game to make it fun!
author: FromBiotoDev
selftext:
Hi all,

I made [SpellBin](https://spellbin.app/) as a funny none serious mac incremental game

Collect achievements and skins!

Sacrifice your files to the Cauldron!

I used claude code to make the entire game and all the assets, I used Opus 5.5 to make the video using hyperframes primarily, here's the prompt:

>  
`Make a 15-30 second ad in reel and desktop video formats to sell the functionality of spell bin. It should sell the main premise of, bin stuff, make sacrifices, collect achievements, unlock skins. With a CTA at the end for people to check it out. Use spooky halloween music. Loop until the final video is a super polished marketing ad that I can use it in reddit and tiktok`

Happy to answer any questions below :)

comments.author: cheyumaama
comments.body: Looks cool but 5 bucks is overpriced for a pixel pin

replies.author: cheyumaama
replies.body: I don't need it, but if I was interested in it, 2 bucks

replies.author: FromBiotoDev
replies.body: I'm gonna change it to 2 bucks then I reckon, thanks for the feedback!
